title: Edmund and the Parish
author: Ulyana Ravensworth
blurb: Beatrix Delacroix, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
